Changes.note: Bar records a ban that is in force at once: the talebe loses the content in the chosen scope (this course, or every course of the köşk), cannot apply again and cannot leave the course. The ban and its reason go to the audit log; the köşk's nazıms and every Medaris nazım get a notification with the reason, the Medaris başnazım does not; the talebe is told only that their access was removed, without the reason. A ban is never deleted: the kademe that placed it, or a higher one, lifts it with a reason, which is recorded with the lifter's name and told to nobody. Approve turns a waiting application into a seat at once and notifies the talebe, even when the applicant is barred.
